summary.text: A son of Eurystheus king of Mycenae, slain with his brothers when the Athenians fought Eurystheus rather than surrender the Heraclids to his vengeance.
Homonym guard: not Eurybius son of Neleus among Nestor's brothers (Bibliotheca 1.9.9). Apollodorus names this Eurybius only among the sons of Eurystheus slain at Athens.

story.text: Apollodorus counts Eurybius among the sons of Eurystheus whom the Athenians killed in the war over the Heraclids — listed after Alexander and Iphimedon and before Mentor and Perimedes. Their deaths preceded their father's flight and slaying by Hyllus at the Scironian cliffs.
